source.author: cic
source.text: Cavendum autem est, ne aut tarditatibus utamur in ingressu mollioribus, ut pomparum ferculis similes esse videamur, aut in festinationibus suscipiamus nimias celeritates, quae cum fiunt, anhelitus moventur, vultus mutantur, ora torquentur; ex quibus magna significatio fit non adesse constantiam.
source.text_original: Cavendum autem est, ne aut tarditatibus utamur in ingressu mollioribus, ut pomparum ferculis similes esse videamur, aut in festinationibus suscipiamus nimias celeritates, quae cum fiunt, anhelitus moventur, vultus mutantur, ora torquentur; ex quibus magna significatio fit non adesse constantiam.
source.text_english: But care must be taken that we do not use too sluggish a pace in walking, so as to seem like the bearers in processions, nor adopt excessive haste in rushing about; for when people do this, their breathing becomes labored, their faces change, and their features are contorted. From these things it is clearly shown that steadiness is absent.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: qui uero pauperes sunt et tenui substantiola uidenturque sibi scioli, pomparum ferculis similes procedunt ad publicum, ut caninam exerceant facundiam.
reuse.text_original: qui uero pauperes sunt et tenui substantiola uidenturque sibi scioli, pomparum ferculis similes procedunt ad publicum, ut caninam exerceant facundiam.
reuse.text_english: But those who are poor and seem to themselves to be little experts go out into public like the dishes in a procession, so that they may practice doglike eloquence.
